title: AI Trading Consultant
author: Hefty_Vermicelli_802
selftext:
\\\*DISCLAIMER: I’m not promoting or selling anything, and I won’t take any conversations outside of Reddit.\\\*

I am testing a personal trading agent that helps identify emerging opportunities, allocate capital, and  improve investment decision-making.

The goal is to save me time reading, studying and analyzing companies and stock; I will still do it on the side but I am trying to implement what I learn and my investment approach into the agent. Also, I want to correct my tendency to be a reluctant seller.

The system is designed to seek asymmetric upside through a combination of growth compounders and emerging category leaders. It reflects my pretty aggressive / medium risk approach and conviction in a couple of high-potential (to me) industries.

The goals of this post are:

\\\* exchange ideas / lessons learned and insights with people who already built something similar \\\* share outcome of the model and brainstorm on improvements \\\* evaluate performances and best approach

I have a working MVP, that I am testing but I am far from the final product I have in mind. The agent has been running for 2 weeks only so I don't have many performance data points yet.

I am happy to discuss details on the architecture, models I used, guidelines, etc.

\\\*\\\*\\\*\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\*IMPORTANT: I don’t expect this to be a panacea or deliver crazy returns. The goal is to save me time, and correct my tendency to be a reluctant seller.\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\*\\\*\\\*\\\*
